steps.expr: (() => { const st=[...document.querySelectorAll('text')].find(t=>t.textContent==='AOD098'); if(!st) return 'not found'; const m=st.transform.baseVal.consolidate().matrix; const b=st.getBBox(); const pt=(x,y)=>({x:+(m.a*x+m.c*y+m.e).toFixed(1), y:+(m.b*x+m.d*y+m.f).toFixed(1)}); const bl=[pt(b.x,0),pt(b.x+b.width,0)]; return JSON.stringify({baselineEnds:bl, vertical:bl[0].x===bl[1].x, inkSpanX:[bl[0].x, +(bl[0].x+b.height).toFixed(1)]}); })()
